No dedicated corporate website found distinct from sister BNPL brand aajil.sa; leadership named (Abdulla Sheikh, Faisal Chowdhry) but no contact details found. Re-check in ~6-8 weeks for commencement confirmation.

description: Newly formed Saudi joint stock company, sister firm to Aajil (aajil.sa), an AI-driven B2B 'buy now, pay later' platform supplying industrial SMEs with raw materials on deferred terms (SAR 600m supplied as of 2026-08-31). Aajil Capital received a CMA licence (Board resolution dated 2026-06-22, licence no. 26358-02) to conduct the Managing Investments activity, and has not yet commenced regulated operations pending completion of commencement-of-business requirements. Once live, plans to offer Shariah-compliant investment management giving investors exposure to Saudi industrial SMEs, building on sister-company origination data. Chaired by Abdulla Sheikh; CEO/CIO is Faisal Chowdhry, a former Goldman Sachs executive.

fit.reasoning: Fit: priority segment asset manager (20) + priority market KSA (15) + likely single-strategy at launch (private credit/SME exposure) rather than clearly multi-asset yet (0) + will manage third-party investor capital, not proprietary (10) + CMA-regulated (5) = 50/60 (docked the multi-asset points until the fund/mandate structure is public). Timing: a brand-new CMA licence (2026-06-22), pre-commencement — the single cleanest 'new licence, no incumbent system' trigger in this batch (20/25). Access: two named leaders identified (Chairman Abdulla Sheikh; CEO/CIO Faisal Chowdhry) but no verified contact route, and the firm has not commenced operations so there is nobody to sell to yet operationally (8/15, named-not-reachable). Total 78 by table, moderated to 62 given the firm is pre-launch — a real trigger, but timing means outreach should wait for commencement confirmation, not happen now.
